questions.question: What is the product of the reaction between nitromethane and sodium hydroxide?

options.A: Nitromethane is not affected by sodium hydroxide
options.D: Nitromethane dissolves in sodium hydroxide to form a salt

questions.explanation: Nitromethane dissolves in sodium hydroxide to form a salt because of the acidic nature of the alpha-hydrogen atom.

questions.question: Which of the following is a method of preparation of nitroalkanes?

options.A: From alkyl halides by reaction with potassium nitrite
options.B: From alkenes by reaction with nitric acid
options.C: From alkynes by reaction with sodium nitrite

questions.explanation: Nitroalkanes can be prepared from alkyl halides by reaction with potassium nitrite.

questions.question: What is the name of the reaction in which aniline reacts with benzoyl chloride to form N-phenylbenzamide?
questions.explanation: The Schotten-Baumann reaction is a method of preparing amides from amines and acid chlorides.

questions.question: Which of the following amines is most basic?
questions.explanation: Dimethylamine is more basic than aniline and methylamine due to the electron-donating effect of the methyl group.

questions.question: What is the product of the reaction between benzene diazonium chloride and copper(I) cyanide?
questions.explanation: Benzene diazonium chloride reacts with copper(I) cyanide to form benzonitrile.

questions.question: Which of the following is a method of preparation of cyanides?

options.A: From alkyl halides by reaction with sodium cyanide
options.B: From alkenes by reaction with hydrocyanic acid
options.C: From alkynes by reaction with sodium cyanide

questions.explanation: Cyanides can be prepared from alkyl halides by reaction with sodium cyanide.

questions.question: What is the name of the reaction in which primary amines react with chloroform and alcoholic potassium hydroxide to form isocyanides?
questions.explanation: The carbylamine reaction is a method of preparing isocyanides from primary amines.

questions.question: Which of the following is a property of nitroalkanes?

options.A: They are highly polar and have high boiling points
options.B: They are non-polar and have low boiling points
options.C: They are highly reactive and explosive

questions.explanation: Nitroalkanes are highly polar and have high boiling points due to the presence of the nitro group.

questions.question: What is the product of the reaction between aniline and nitrous acid?
questions.explanation: Aniline reacts with nitrous acid to form benzene diazonium chloride.

questions.question: Which of the following is a method of preparation of amines?

options.B: From alkyl halides by reaction with ammonia
options.C: From alkenes by reaction with hydrocyanic acid

questions.explanation: Amines can be prepared from nitro compounds by reduction.
